description: This file defines a static class and a readonly struct related to handling directory results within the Orleans runtime, including methods for creating instances and retrieving results based on version matching.

classes.name: DirectoryResult
classes.description: A static class providing factory methods for DirectoryResult instances.

classes.name: DirectoryResult<T>
classes.description: A readonly struct representing the result of a directory operation, including versioning and result retrieval logic.

methods.name: FromResult
methods.description: Creates a DirectoryResult instance containing a result and version.

methods.name: RefreshRequired
methods.description: Creates a DirectoryResult indicating a refresh is required, with a specified version.

methods.name: TryGetResult
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve the result if the version matches.
